picks.why: Vistra trades at 14.2x forward earnings with 31% operating margin and 28% revenue growth, 29% below its high, so the price already carries a lot of the policy fear. It is a cash-generating way to own the power constraint, and the watchlist has no power_nuclear name active.
picks.risk: Data-centre restrictions or a hot CPI could keep power stocks falling, and the 2% FCF yield gives little cushion.

picks.why: Nvidia is 11.2x forward earnings with 106% revenue growth and 66% operating margin, 27% off its high after losing $190bn on the Huang probe. The price now limits the downside if the probe fades, and TSMC's 59.7% sales jump shows demand is intact.
picks.risk: The probe widening into China export curbs or a governance change would make the cheap multiple a trap.
